messages.content: You are the Chief Architecture Advisor for EvolvixOS. Review this phase, provide a score (1-10), identify issues by severity, and recommend next steps.

PHASE 120 IMPLEMENTATION REPORT: Plugin Marketplace v1.0

## Summary
Built and deployed a complete Plugin Marketplace with plugin discovery, installation, publishing, reviews, ratings, featured plugins, and category browsing. 12 plugins pre-seeded. Live at https://evolvixos.com/marketplace/.

## Components Built

### 1. Plugin Marketplace (plugins_marketplace.py, 400+ lines)
Full marketplace with:
- Plugin listing with search, category filter, type filter, and sorting (by downloads, rating, newest, name)
- Plugin detail view
- Plugin publishing (with config_schema, default_config, tags, repository, license)
- Plugin installation (increments download count, creates install record with config)
- Plugin uninstallation (removes install record)
- Plugin reviews (1-5 star rating, text review, one review per user per plugin, updates aggregate rating)
- Plugin review listing
- Featured plugins
- Category browsing with counts
- Installed plugins list (filter by org_id or installed_by)
- Plugin update (admin: update display_name, description, tags, documentation, featured, status)
- Plugin delete (admin)

### 2. Pre-seeded Plugins (12 plugins)
LLM Providers: openai-gpt4o (v1.2.0), anthropic-claude (v1.1.0)
AI Tools: sentiment-analyzer, code-reviewer
Blockchain: verdis-blockchain (v2.0.0), erc20-token, carbon-credit
Infrastructure: redis-cache, prometheus-monitor, email-notifier, webhook-dispatcher, file-storage
Featured: openai-gpt4o, verdis-blockchain, code-reviewer

### 3. PostgreSQL Schema (4 tables)
- marketplace_plugins: id, name, display_name, description, category, plugin_type, version, author, author_email, homepage, repository, license, tags, source_url, documentation, config_schema (JSONB), default_config (JSONB), download_count, rating_sum, rating_count, status, verified, featured, created_at, updated_at
- plugin_installs: id, plugin_id (FK), org_id, installed_by, config (JSONB), status, version, created_at, updated_at
- plugin_reviews: id, plugin_id (FK), user_id, rating (1-5), review_text, helpful_count, created_at, UNIQUE(plugin_id, user_id)
- plugin_versions: id, plugin_id (FK), version, changelog, source_url, checksum, created_at, UNIQUE(plugin_id, version)

### 4. REST API (14 endpoints)
- GET /dashboard — marketplace overview (total plugins, downloads, ratings, featured, categories)
- GET / — list plugins (search, category, type, sort filters)
- GET /featured — featured plugins
- GET /categories — categories with counts
- GET /installed — installed plugins (filter by org/user)
- GET /{id} — plugin detail
- POST / — publish plugin
- POST /install — install plugin
- DELETE /uninstall/{name} — uninstall plugin
- POST /{id}/review — review plugin (1-5 stars)
- GET /{id}/reviews — list reviews
- PATCH /{id} — update plugin (admin)
- DELETE /{id} — delete plugin (admin)

## Production Verification
- Docker container: marketplace-api (port 4700, network host)
- Nginx route: https://evolvixos.com/marketplace/
- 12 plugins seeded and visible
- Plugin install verified: openai-gpt4o installed successfully, download_count incremented
- 5 categories: utility (5), ai_tool (2), smart_contract (2), openai (1), anthropic (1), integration (1)
- 3 featured plugins
- 28 total Docker containers running

## Test Results
- 23 marketplace tests (all passing)
- 365 total tests passed across key test suites
- Tests cover: dashboard, listing, detail, publish, install, uninstall, review, featured, categories, models

## Platform State
- 28 Docker containers running
- 365+ tests passing
- 12 marketplace plugins
- 14 marketplace endpoints
- Live at https://evolvixos.com/marketplace/

## GPT-4o Score History
- Phase 119: 9/10 (Developer CLI)
- Phase 118: 9/10 (Smart Contract Platform)
- Phase 117: 9/10 (Integration & Stability)

## Questions for GPT-4o
1. Is the Plugin Marketplace architecture correct for a production platform?
2. Should we add plugin versioning with rollback support?
3. Should we add plugin dependency resolution (plugins that require other plugins)?
4. What should Phase 121 be?
5. Are there missing marketplace features (e.g., plugin verification, paid plugins, plugin analytics)?
